text: The purpose of this report is to obtain approval for the installation/removal of on-street accessible parking spaces for persons with disabilities. As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on the subject street, City Council approval of this report is required.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation/removal of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Appendix A to the report (June 14, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
